svg.title: A = CR: independent columns and their coordinates
svg.desc: A = [[1,0,1,2],[0,1,1,-1],[1,1,2,1]]. C contains the first two columns. R = [[1,0,1,2],[0,1,1,-1]]. First apply R to obtain (s,t), then C to obtain (s,t,s+t). All outputs lie in the plane y3=y1+y2.
